feed.hub_link.note: A feed names its hub with a link whose rel is hub, and its own address with a link whose rel is self, in the feed and in the HTTP headers. From the WebSub Recommendation; the page was not re-read for this build.

feed.self_link.note: Each language feed uses its own exact address as its self link, never a redirect.

ping.format.note: A ping is a form POST with hub.mode=publish and hub.url set to the feed address, and a hub answers with a 2xx code. Hubs differ in what else they accept, so the test shows the answer of your own hub.

ping.queue.note: A ping is sent from the background queue, never inside the save. A failed ping is tried again after 1, 5 and 15 minutes, up to 4 attempts, then it shows Failed.

hub.default.note: There is no default hub. Nothing is sent until the owner enters one.
